_about: Does the app have its packaged mode (WP14 part 2, WA.2: src/pkg.rs: data in the package's LocalState, the web view in LocalCache, attachments in TempState, the keyring service heylook.store, the package's AppUserModelID for toasts, updater off, the startup task)? While appPackagedMode is false the release workflow still builds and checks the package, but names the tag-run artifact msix-store-NOT-READY and store-submit refuses to run: such a package would try to update itself inside the read-only package and keep its data in a virtualised AppData. Set to true by WP14 part 2; scripts/test-msix-build.mjs then requires the packaged-mode code to be in the sources, and the job msix-check of the release workflow requires the database in LocalState on the runner. If a dry run's msix-check fails, set it back to false until the cause is fixed.
